title: finished-work tests time out on the Windows CI job
notes: Two tests in src/main/workers/finished-work.test.ts hit vitest's 5 s timeout on the windows job of PR #402 (a docs-only PR, run 45830087851), and main's CI failed then passed on 79dd5def today. Suspect: #393 made these tests run against a real bare origin (git init, push, fetch), and git process spawns are several times slower on Windows runners. Do: find which tests time out from the run's log, then make them fast (share one bare origin per file, or fewer git calls) rather than only raising the timeout; if a raise is the honest fix, raise it for those tests alone and say why. Confirm by a green windows job on two runs.

comments.body: Not flaky: the windows re-run of 45830087851 failed the same test again at 5019 ms: finished-work.test.ts > unfinishedWork, with the board a stale copy of origin's > lets go of a worktree whose only change is its own card file, once origin has held it. It blocks #402 and every PR's windows job.
Pull request #404 opened: Build the finished-work tests' git repository once and copy it per test https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/404

Review loop converged in 1 round: the review posted no findings and the loop pushed no commits. CI passed on b646b4b9, the windows job included. Ready to merge. Still open: the card asks for a green windows job on two runs, and this is one.
